author: CNN
description: More than two dozen people were held hostage in a bank in Naples, Italy, according to Italian news agency LaPresse. The hostages were held for about an hour and a half in an incident that happened around 12:30pm on Thursday. A nationwide search is underway for three or four robbers who escaped through a tunnel and into the sewers, the Naples prosecutor general told CNN. #naples #robbery #cnn
title: Over two dozen held hostage in Italian bank robbery

author: CNN
description:
Iran announced that it had reopened the Strait of Hormuz and later shut it down again, blaming the US for "breaches of trust" during the ongoing ceasefire. The move may threaten momentum toward a peace deal between the two countries. President Donald Trump said negotiations were still progressing. Meanwhile, Trump announced a temporary ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon.

Here's a roundup of retired US military analyzing the seventh week of the Iran war.

0:00 Vice Adm. Kevin Donegan (Ret.) on Iran closing the Strait again and Iran's uranium
5:04 Lt. Gen. Karen Gibson (Ret.) on what she's watching for in the Strait of Hormuz and how the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire is working
7:37 Gen. David Petraeus (Ret.) on reopening the Strait of Hormuz and prospects of an eventual deal
11:34 Gen. Wesley Clark (Ret.) on reopening the Strait of Hormuz
14:23 Gen. Stanley McChrystal (Ret.) on who holds the advantage and how talks may affect US allies in the Gulf
19:04 Lt. Gen. Russel Honoré (Ret.) on I
title: Retired generals break down Iran war strategy after week 7

description: Iranian Revolutionary Guards gunboats fired on two tankers traveling through the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday, according to an advisory from the UK Maritime Traffic Organization. description:
US President Donald Trump expressed confidence Friday that the sides are close to a deal, but a senior Iranian official cast doubt on some of his claims about Tehran making concessions.

Meanwhile, only a handful of ships passed through the key waterway Friday, despite Iran’s foreign minister saying it was open to commercial vessels. The Iranian parliament speaker said the strait will close again if the US doesn’t lift its naval blockade in the region.

Is Trump hyping a deal where there is none? A CNN NewsNight panel debates.

0:00 Can the word of Trump or Iran be trusted?
4:12 Are we better off than we were under the previous Iran nuclear deal?  
6:47 Is the Strait of Hormuz actually open?

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#Trump #Iran #News
title: Debate: Is Trump hyping a nonexistent deal with Iran?

description: Thousands of women and young girls attended the “Devoted Girls of Iran” rally in central Tehran Friday. Pro-regime protests across Iran by the general population have been an almost daily occurrence since Ayatollah Ali Hosseini Khamenei, who ruled Iran with an iron fist as its supreme leader for nearly four decades, was killed on February 28 after US and Israeli joint strikes targeting his regime. #iran #us #israel #cnn
title: Women and girls attend defiant protest in Iran against the US and Israel
